subject: [PATCH v9 26/32] mm/khugepaged: treat PMD swap entries as mapped THPs

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged code to treat PMD swap entries as mapped THPs, allowing them to be handled similarly to present huge PMDs. This change affects how MADV_COLLAPSE behaves when encountering swapped-out THPs, ensuring that they are correctly collapsed and made resident on demand. The approach taken involves modifying the check_pmd_state function to return SCAN_PMD_MAPPED for PMD swap entries, enabling khugepaged to manage these ranges more efficiently.
